title: Meganium Fights by Making Foes Too Calm

direction.premise: Meganium battles by releasing more flower fragrance to blunt an opponent's fighting spirit.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Meganium turns calming flower fragrance into a battle strategy.
direction.openLoop: How can a soothing flower fragrance work in the middle of a battle?
direction.payoff: Meganium gives off more becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.
direction.engagementQuestion: Would you call this strategy clever or annoying?

voice.instructions: Speak warmly and quickly, with playful disbelief. Stress calm, more, and fighting spirit. Pause briefly before the final question.
